_comment: GREEN baseline control: count_tokens never carries affinity or compat. F5.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false
bearer_session_compat = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.anth]
dialect = "anthropic"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"
count_tokens = true
session_header = "x-affinity"
session_missing = "reject"


[[models]]
name = "claude-sess"
provider = "anth"
model = "claude-haiku-4-5"
name: m4_compat_off_count_no_affinity
